Vivek is an active angel investor and mentor, backing startups across multiple sectors, including consumer internet, fintech, and SaaS. He has invested in and advised companies such as Nivesh.com, Cashify, Happily Unmarried, Jaypore, and MEDdelivery. His passion for supporting founders extends to his role as a Strategic Advisor at LetsVenture.

people.name: Vivek Vaidya
people.role: Co-founder and General Partner, super{set} startup studio
bio: Vivek Vaidya is a Founder and Trustee of Plaksha University. Vivek is a serial entrepreneur and technology leader who has built industry-leading technology companies in enterprise software, data management, analytics, and machine learning and AI over the last 25 years. Currently, he is the Founder, General Partner, and CTO of Super{set}, a startup studio that funds and builds data-driven technology companies. Prior to forming Super{set}, Vivek was the CTO of Salesforce Marketing Cloud, having joined Salesforce via the acquisition of Krux, a mar-tech platform that he co-founded with Tom Chavez in 2010. Before Krux, Vivek served as the CTO of Rapt, a provider of software for media monetization acquired by Microsoft in 2008.

Vivek holds an MS in Mathematics and Computer Applications from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and an MS in Computer Science from the University of Denver. While at IIT Delhi, he was an early member of the team at Parsec Technologies, the first company to build and market Interactive Voice Response systems in India. Vivek lives in San Francisco with his wife Pallavi and son Viplav and is a co-author of Data-Driven: Harnessing Data and AI to Reinvent Customer Engagement, published in 2018.

people.name: Alok Goyal
bio: Alok is a Founder of Plaksha University. When Alok is not busy being involved with investment projects in SaaS, logistics, and automotive, he can often be seen ensuring the adequate supply of much-adored snacks in the office premises and, of course, seeing to it that the fun levels at work never drop below optimum levels. His interest in venture capital stems from the energy he derives from meetings with entrepreneurs. Moreover, he strongly believes that to be an entrepreneur, one needs to be a dreamer and indeed be foolish (read courageous) enough to pursue the dream. According to Alok, the ability to pursue one's dreams in an unfettered way is what makes entrepreneurs truly special, and so, he believes that there is something to be learned from every entrepreneur.

Alok's previous endeavors included leading enterprise software and outsourcing investments at Helion, where he invested in Whatfix, Axtria, Pipemonk (ACQD: Freshdesk) and Linguanext (ACQD: Fidel Technologies). In addition, Alok was previously involved in various leadership roles at SAP in India and the US, as well as a series of roles at Siebel Systems, The McKenna Group, McKinsey and Company, and Cadence Design Systems. As far as his hobbies are concerned, he writes a weekly blog on mathematical puzzles (alokgoyal1971.com) and dabbles in light and classical Hindustani music. He is a passionate foodie as well (hence chief in charge of the snacks supply), and is maniacal about fitness.

people.name: Alok Ramsisaria
bio: Alok Ramsisaria is a Founder of Plaksha University. Alok Ramsisaria is the CEO of Grazitti Interactive, where he leads the company's strategy across marketing, sales, and customer success. Grazitti is a bootstrapped digital innovation company helping global businesses transform customer experience through marketing automation, communities, analytics, and AI.

With over 35 years of experience across technology, marketing, and consulting, Alok has scaled Grazitti from its inception in India into a global organization of over a thousand people—without external funding. He believes in AI as a multiplier for talent, enabling teams to deliver greater impact rather than replacing them.

He focuses on building scalable systems and high-performance teams, driving consistent, year-on-year growth while serving global enterprises. Alok is also a Co-founder of Chandigarh Angels Network (CAN), an early-stage angel network that supports and mentors startups across North India.

people.name: Ashish Kumar
bio: Ashish Kumar is a Founder of Plaksha University. Ashish Kumar is the Managing Partner and CIO at Infinity Alternatives. Prior to founding Infinity Alternatives, Ashish was the India Head for PineBridge Investments. He has also worked at Bank of America. Ashish has a BTech from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and an MBA from the Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad.

people.name: Carl George Dürschmidt
people.role: Chairperson of the Supervisory Board, Nagarro
bio: Carl George Dürschmidt is a Founder of Plaksha University. Carl George Dürschmidt, who spreads his time between Germany and South Africa, is a long-time investor and recent farmer. He is the Chair of the Supervisory Board of Nagarro and, separately, of Allgeier, and is effectively the largest shareholder in both companies. After studying business economics, Carl first worked for the family business. In 1986, he joined an international business consultancy, where he was in charge of the strategic advisory to small and medium-sized enterprises. From 1989, he worked for an investment company that mainly developed participations in German SMEs. After an IPO of one of these companies, he joined the Executive Board in 1992. Then, after founding a private investment company together with partners, he was responsible for the development and management of a portfolio of SMEs. He took an equity participation in Allgeier over 15 years ago and ran the company as CEO until 2021.

people.name: Deepak Goyal
people.role: Managing Director and Senior Partner, Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
bio: Deepak Goyal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Deepak is a Managing Director and Senior Partner at Boston Consulting Group (BCG) and a core member of the firm's Financial Institutions and Marketing, Sales and Pricing practices. He globally leads BCG's Fintech segment and has previously led the Wholesale Banking practice in North America, as well as the Marketing, Sales, and Pricing practice in Financial Institutions worldwide.

Since joining BCG in 2004, Deepak has advised global clients on strategy, pricing, operations, IT, organization design and large-scale business transformation. His expertise spans wholesale banking, corporate finance, revenue management and people strategy.

Before joining BCG, Deepak worked at McKinsey in India, where he developed a deep understanding of financial institutions and market dynamics. With a strong background in strategy and execution, he continues to shape the future of financial services through data-driven insights and transformative business solutions.

people.name: Dilipkumar Khandelwal
people.role: Managing Director and CEO, Deutsche India
bio: Dilipkumar Khandelwal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Dilip is the Managing Director and CEO of Deutsche India. He is also the Global Chief Information Officer for Corporate Functions Technology at Deutsche Bank. He is a proven leader with over 20 years of experience running large technology organizations. Prior to Deutsche Bank, Dilip was the Global Head and President of the SAP HANA Enterprise Cloud business. During his tenure as Managing Director, SAP India was rated #1 in the ‘Great Place to Work’ ranking. He is an Advisory Board member at the Indian Institute of Information Technology and is an Executive Council member at NASSCOM. He has been an advisor in venture capital and private equity firms. His strength in driving innovation and his entrepreneurial mindset have allowed him to follow his passion for mentoring startups and acting as an angel investor to multiple companies like Whatfix, Yellow.ai, Moglix, and Mamaearth. Dilip is a graduate in Engineering from Mumbai University and holds a Management degree from the Indian School of Business and has been awarded the 40 Under 40 Award by The Economic Times.

people.name: Dr Ashish Gupta
bio: "Focus on the Process - outcomes will follow eventually." Dr Ashish Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. He is a Founder of Helion Venture Partners and serves on several boards, including Hindustan Unilever, Info Edge (Naukri), Pubmatic, Simplilearn, and Workspot. Prior to Helion, he co-founded two successful companies - Junglee (AMZN) and Tavant Technologies. He also worked at Woodside Fund, Oracle, and IBM. His other investments include Daksh (IBM), MMYT, MuSigma, UPWK, Flipkart (Walmart), and Perfios. Ashish enjoys working with startups with a particular interest in product and leadership. Ashish is a Kauffman Fellow, holds a PhD from Stanford University, and a BTech from IIT Kanpur, where he was awarded the President's Gold Medal and later nominated to the list of 50 notable alumni.

people.name: Jitendra Gupta
bio: Jitendra Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. Jitendra is founder of Amica Financial (Jupiter). He aims to create a mobile-first banking experience for Indian millennials. The idea is to create a savvy and cost-effective banking experience and at the same time help youth manage their money better. Before Jupiter, Jitendra founded LazyPay and was MD of PayU India. Prior to PayU, he had founded Citrus Pay, a leading digital payments company in India. The same was sold to Naspers in Sep 2016 for USD 130 million in one of the most successful fintech exits. He has more than 16 years of work experience in the banking and financial services industry and is considered an expert in the payments industry. Prior to Citrus, he was working with ICICI Bank for 7 years, wherein he was part of the founding team of retail cross-sell and investment banking division in the bank. During his last stint with the bank, he led the whole initiative of stitching a joint venture between ICICI Bank and First Data in the Indian market. This was a unique JV ever done between a bank and an independent payments company. In 4 years, he had grown Citrus into a 300-member+ strong team and raised over USD 25 million. Citrus counts its investor base from Sequoia Capital and E-context Japan to Ascent Capital in Series C round. In 2016, Citrus was sold to Naspers in one of the largest fintech exits in India. He has graduated from Sydenham College, Mumbai and is a qualified Chartered Accountant. He also created the pay later brand LazyPay and scaled it to more than 1 million active consumers using the brand on a monthly basis.

people.name: Kaushal Aggarwal
bio: Kaushal Aggarwal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Kaushal is the Co-founder of Avendus and oversees the firm's credit solutions and wealth management businesses. With over 20 years of global experience in financial services, he has played a key role in shaping Avendus into a leading financial institution. Kaushal was instrumental in creating the investment banking business at Avendus, leveraging his expertise in financial strategy, capital markets and advisory services. Before co-founding Avendus, he worked with Kotak Mahindra Bank's investment banking practice, where he gained deep insights into deal structuring and corporate finance. His leadership has been pivotal in driving Avendus' expansion and strengthening its position in the financial services industry.

people.name: Krish Mantripragada
people.role: Chief Product and Technology Officer, Seismic
people.education: PhD, Supply Chain Management (Massachusetts Institute of Technology)
bio: "The best way to predict the future is to create it" Krish Mantripragada is a Founder of Plaksha University. Krish is an innovative and entrepreneurial senior executive who has spent over two decades building software solutions at multiple pioneering and leading companies. Over his career he has helped create new product categories, scale businesses, build teams from the ground up and had two successful IPOs (Medallia (NYSE: MDLA) and First Data (NYSE: FDC)). Krish currently serves as the Chief Product and Technology Officer of Seismic, global enterprise SaaS leader in enablement with over 2,000 organizations worldwide trusting its award-winning Seismic Enablement Cloud™ to enable teams and ignite revenue growth. In his role, he is responsible for R&D (Product, Design, Engineering, Support and Operations) and Product Marketing. Previously, Krish was EVP and Chief Product Officer of Medallia where he was responsible for the vision, roadmap and delivery of all products and solutions, leading to its successful IPO on NYSE in 2019. Medallia is a pioneer in customer experience management with over a thousand of the world's leading brands leveraging Medallia Experience Cloud™, a software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform, to win through customer experience. Previously, he was SVP and GM of Information and Analytics Solutions at First Data. He was part of the leadership team that turned the company around and took it public in 2015. Previously, Krish held several leadership positions at SAP, i2 Technologies, Agile Software and United Technologies Research. He has more than 20 years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, analytics and cloud applications and has built several multi-million-dollar product businesses over his career. Krish lives in Silicon Valley, CA with his wife and two kids. He is an active investor, mentor and advisor to several startups.

people.name: Manipal Dhariwal
bio: Manipal Dhariwal is a Founder of Plaksha University. Manipal is the Co-founder and CEO of the Netsmartz Group. He leads a team of over 1,500 professionals across 10+ global locations, helping organizations re-imagine themselves as 21st-century enterprises with technology at the core. Under his leadership, Netsmartz has been ranked among the top 100 fastest-growing companies in Rochester, New York. Over the past 26 years, Manipal has built a distinguished footprint in the global IT ecosystem. In addition to founding multiple award-winning technology companies—including Netsmartz, CloudSmartz, Sebiz Infotech, Caresmartz, DynamicsSmartz, Envision Ecommerce, and APPWorx—he actively supports a portfolio of more than 20 startups across the world. A first-generation serial entrepreneur, he is passionate about transforming startups into scale-ups. He has driven business investments of over USD 100 million in Northern India and has been instrumental in creating more than 1,500 direct jobs and approximately 3,500 indirect jobs. He is the Founder and Chapter President of the Startup Accelerator Chamber of Commerce (SACC), a member of YPO and EO, Advisor to TEDx Chandigarh, Chairman of the IT and ITES Entrepreneurship/Startup Committee (ASSOCHAM), Charter Member of TiE, and President of the Mohali IT City Association. He collaborates actively with institutions across India to strengthen and accelerate the country's startup ecosystem. Beyond entrepreneurship, Manipal is an avid golfer and a committed philanthropist. His social impact efforts focus on promoting entrepreneurship, supporting social causes and community development, and driving sustainability and corporate social responsibility initiatives.

people.name: Manish Gupta
bio: Manish Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. Manish Gupta is the Co-founder and CEO of Indegene. He has an enviable track record of spearheading the spectacular growth of Indegene from an initial Indian startup to a globally respected technology-led healthcare solutions organization. He is acknowledged as a pioneer and thought leader in the global life sciences digital transformation space. He is a BTech graduate from IIT-BHU, India, and holds a Master's degree in Business Administration from IIM Ahmedabad (1998), India. He is the recipient of the Young Alumni Award for Entrepreneurship from IIM Ahmedabad, India, and the Distinguished Alumnus Award from IIT-BHU, India.

people.name: Manish Krishnan
bio: Manish Krishnan is a seasoned entrepreneur, investor, and advisor, currently serving as a Senior Advisor at Nagarro, a digital product engineering firm listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. Previously, he was Managing Director at Nagarro. In 2021, Nagarro acquired ATCS Inc., a global IT consulting firm founded by Manish. ATCS delivers digital and analytics solutions to Fortune 500 clients across pharmaceuticals, healthcare, finance, and automotive sectors, with offices in six countries. Manish is also Chairman of the Board at Quintype Technologies, an AI-powered digital experience platform for news and media publishers. Quintype is a subsidiary of Quint Digital Limited (QDL), India's premier digital media technology company listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange. Additionally, he serves as Chairman of the Board at ListenFirst Media, a New York-based social media analytics and insights platform supporting Fortune 500 companies in media, entertainment, gaming and other industries. As a mentor in the Creative Destruction Lab (CDL) AI stream at the University of Toronto, Manish actively guides startups, helping them scale and succeed in the competitive tech landscape. Beyond business, Manish is deeply committed to philanthropy. He serves on the Board of the Eye-Bank for Sight Restoration in New York, a distinguished non-profit focused on curing blindness through transplantation. He is also leading the development of Altrus HealthCare for Women and Children in India, a hospital dedicated to providing high-quality healthcare for women and children, with a mission to support underprivileged communities. Manish holds an MBA from Columbia University and a bachelor's degree from BITS Pilani, India. He has also completed the Executive Education Program on Leading Professional Service Firms at Harvard Business School. In recognition of his entrepreneurial achievements, he was named 'EY Entrepreneur of the Year (New Jersey)' in 2021.

people.name: Manmohan Gupta
bio: Manmohan Gupta is a Founder of Plaksha University. Manmohan is Co-founder of Nagarro and has evolved from being the leading technologist to being the human resources guru. He mentors Nagarro's technical managers and staff while ensuring that HR practices keep in line with Nagarro's historical DNA and ethos. He is responsible for all hiring and training of technical personnel and has been instrumental in building a world-class engineering team. Manmohan has more than 17 years of experience in software architecture, design and development. He has extensive experience in the architecture of portal solutions, workflow systems, e-commerce platforms, e-learning solutions, business intelligence and reporting systems**.** Manmohan is also a founder-partner of the leading education firm Vidya Mandir Classes, which was acquired by Educomp Solutions in 2010. He holds a Bachelor of Electrical Engineering degree from IIT Delhi.

people.name: Mekin Maheshwari
people.role: Founder and CEO, Udhyam Learning Foundation
bio: Mekin Maheshwari is a Founder of Plaksha University. Mekin is the Founder and CEO of Udhyam Learning Foundation. Udhyam Learning Foundation is a non-profit that has enabled entrepreneurial mindsets for over 16 lakh government school and ITI students across 8 states in India and an annual income uplift of Rs 20 crore for 5000 Istri entrepreneurs. He is also a Co-founder of Global Alliance for Mass Entrepreneurship (G.A.M.E) and Social Change at ACT Grants and an independent board member at TeamLease. As an angel investor and philanthropist, he is focused on creating impact at scale in the fields of human capital and ed-tech with investments in companies such as Urban Company and Quizizz. An engineer by education, Mekin started his career at Yahoo! and has held entrepreneurial roles throughout his career. Before Udhyam, he helped Flipkart through its scale journey. He was an early leader at Flipkart. He started when the company operated out of a 2-room house, building and leading the most impactful technology team in the country to eventually play the role of Chief People Officer for a 35k strong team. Mekin deeply cares about people realizing their potential and succeeding in life.

people.name: Mohit Gupta
bio: Mohit is a Founder of Plaksha University. Mohit is a business leader with a track record in building and scaling category-defining businesses in food delivery and travel e-commerce. He held key leadership roles at Zomato and MakeMyTrip, both of which he helped build from formative stages to IPOs and beyond. He has also invested in and mentored startups, and contributed to significant MandA events in the Indian e-commerce sector. During his decade-long stint with PepsiCo, he handled sales, brand marketing and channel leadership assignments across levels and geographies. He is now building an omnichannel premium fashion platform at Lyskraft.

people.name: Nitin Monga
bio: Nitin Monga is a Founder of Plaksha University. Nitin Monga is a first-generation entrepreneur driven by a deep belief that technology is magic. It can be used to unlock dignity, equity, and opportunity especially for those who have historically been left out. With over two decades of experience across governance, grassroots transformation, and enterprise technology, he has focused on building systems that solve real, large-scale problems. Growing up with a close view of rural India's aspirations and constraints, Nitin's professional journey has always been deeply personal. In 2007, he founded WE Excel with a bold idea: to solve real, persistent problems in India through e-governance. The early days were uncertain, but fueled by clarity of purpose and hands-on leadership, he built a respected e-governance solutions company from the ground up. Nitin is best known for conceiving E-Kharid / Anaajkharid, a now-benchmark public food procurement platform that revolutionized how farmers in Haryana and Punjab sell their crops and receive payments. What sets him apart is not just the scale of the platforms he has built, but his instinct for public good, empathy for the last-mile user, and discipline in building trust with institutions and citizens alike. His approach blends visionary thinking with quiet resilience, never chasing headlines, always focused on systemic value. Whether it is transforming the public education system through personalized digital learning or building India's next-generation ERP engine for the public sector, Nitin focuses on not just building technology but long-term capacity. He also co-founded Appworx, iProfit, and Cropbiz. Beyond products, he invests deeply in people and ecosystems. As a Co-founder at SACC India, he mentors early-stage startups from Tier 2 and rural belts, believing that empowering youth and women to solve local problems is India's greatest untapped advantage. Under his guidance, SACC has become one of the most trusted incubation platforms in North India, reaching 300,000+ youth and supporting 500+ startups. In every room he is in, Nitin brings calm clarity, a systems perspective, and deep personal integrity. His work is about simplifying complexity, amplifying impact, and creating infrastructure that quietly empowers millions. Looking ahead, Nitin is focused on collaborating with like-minded people and organizations to shape public digital infrastructure that is inclusive, intelligent, and rooted in India's realities, with a strong belief that technology can accelerate India's journey from a developing to a developed nation.

people.name: Nitin Seth
bio: Nitin Seth is a Founder of Plaksha University. Nitin Seth is a global business leader, entrepreneur, and bestselling author. He is the Co-founder and CEO of Incedo Inc., a fast-growing data, digital, and AI services firm. With nearly three decades of leadership experience, Nitin has held pivotal roles at world-class organizations—including Director of McKinsey's Global Knowledge Centre, Managing Director and India Country Head of Fidelity International, and Chief Operating Officer of Flipkart, India's largest e-commerce company. Across these roles, he has led large-scale transformations in business, technology, data, and AI. Nitin is the author of three acclaimed books. His debut, 'Winning in the Digital Age' (2021), became a national bestseller and won five prestigious business book awards, including the C.K. Prahalad Best Business Book Award. His second book, 'Mastering the Data Paradox' (2024), became a bestseller within a week of launch and has already won multiple awards. Nitin's third book, titled 'Human Edge in the AI Age', completing his trilogy on the transformation trifecta of Digital, Data and AI, was published in July 2025. The book, a timely and compelling reflection on the challenges and opportunities for humanity in the AI era—was recognized as an Amazon bestseller even before its release, achieving #1 bestseller position across multiple categories. Within a few days of its release, it also became a national bestseller for Penguin. An alumnus of IIM Lucknow, where he received the Chairman's Gold Medal for academic excellence, and IIT Delhi, Nitin is widely regarded as a thought leader. He is a sought-after speaker on digital transformation, AI, leadership, innovation, and building high-performance teams, passionately inspiring individuals and organizations to thrive in a fast-changing world.

people.name: Pallavi Jain
bio: Pallavi Jain is a Founder of Plaksha University. Pallavi is also a Project Leader at Boston Consulting Group (BCG), who played a key role through a secondment in building Plaksha from scratch since its early days of conceptualization. She has worked at BCG across education and TMT (Technology, Media and Telecom) sectors in a mix of strategy and implementation functions, including a flagship project with the Government of Haryana to transform quality of education in 15,000 schools. She also previously worked at Citibank in corporate banking. Pallavi completed her MBA from IIM Bangalore where she was on the Director's Merit List. She holds an Economics Honors degree from St. Stephen's College, Delhi.

people.name: Prashanth Prakash
bio: Prashanth Prakash is a Founder of Plaksha University. Prashanth Prakash is a Founding Partner of Accel India and a pioneering venture capitalist who has played a crucial role in shaping India's startup ecosystem. He began his venture capital journey in 2004, investing in Indian technology startups long before they gained global prominence.

He co-founded Erasmic Ventures in 2004, one of India's earliest seed funds, which later merged with Accel. Over the years, he has backed and nurtured some of India's most successful startups, including Agrostar, BlueStone, BookMyShow, Clevertap, FabHotels, Glowroad, HolidayMe, HomeLane, InfraMarket, PropTiger, QwikCilver (acquired by Pine Labs), Rentomojo, TeaBox and many others.

Beyond venture capital, Prashanth is deeply involved in fostering innovation and entrepreneurship in Karnataka and across India. As the co-founder of UnboxingBLR Foundation, he actively contributes to initiatives that support emerging businesses and technological advancements.

In recognition of his contributions to India's trade and industry, he was honored with the Padma Shri. His expertise in venture investing, strategic growth, and ecosystem development continues to drive impactful change in India's startup landscape.

people.name: Rajesh Nair
bio: Dr Rajesh Nair is a Founder of Plaksha University. He is one of the Co-founders of Indegene, and the President of the company. His work includes developing new strategic initiatives, especially as they relate to the company's solutions in RWD-driven R&D for the life sciences. He comes with 24 years of experience in the technology-led healthcare solutions provider sector. Dr Nair headed the bio-tech division of the Sarabhai Group before co-founding Indegene. He earned his MBBS from GMC Thiruvananthapuram, India (1993) and is also a physician by training. Post that, he pursued an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad. During his time at IIM Ahmedabad, he was also a member of the Entrepreneurship Club and the IIM Ahmedabad Quiz Club.

people.name: Rajiv Goel
people.education: BCom (Hons), Commerce (Shri Ram College of Commerce)
bio: Rajiv Goel is a Founder of Plaksha University. Rajiv Goel is the Executive Director of Havells. He has been associated with Havells for 12 years prior to which he has worked in FirstRand Bank, Reliance Capital and PriceWaterhouse Coopers. He is a Chartered Accountant (Gold medalist) and has completed his Bachelor's from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi University.

people.name: Ravi Jasuja
people.role: Director, Translational Research and Discovery, BWH, Harvard Medical School
people.education: Fellow, Biophysics/ Physiology (Albert Einstein College of Medicine)
bio: Ravi is a Founder of Plaksha University. Ravi leads a transdisciplinary research program and has made major contributions to science over the past two decades at the interface of engineering, biophysics, and cell signaling for studying diverse biological problems. He is also the Co-founder and Chief Scientific Officer of Function Promoting Therapies LLC.

people.name: Rohit Arora
bio: Rohit Arora is a Founder of Plaksha University. Rohit Arora has been an entrepreneur and investor for over three decades. He is currently the Founder and Chairman of Silverskills Pvt. Ltd. Silverskills and its associate companies provide business process management solutions to companies in the financial services and healthcare sectors globally. Prior to that Rohit had a joint venture with AIA Capital, a member company of American International Group (AIG). AIA Capital India Pvt. Ltd. provided investment banking and corporate finance services to both Indian and multinational corporations. Mr Arora was the Managing Director and Country Head for this company.

Rohit has been an early stage investor in several companies and serves on the Board of listed and unlisted companies as an independent director. Rohit started his career as a management consultant with A.F. Ferguson and Co., the then correspondents of KPMG in India. During this period, he worked on projects for the World Bank, the Indian armed forces, multinational corporations and large Indian public sector corporations. Rohit is a Fellow member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds a B.Com (Honors) from Delhi University.

people.name: Rosen Sharma
people.role: President and CEO, Bluestacks Systems Inc USA

people.name: Sameer Brij Verma
people.education: BS, Computer Engineering (Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago)
bio: Sameer is a Founder of Plaksha University. Sameer is an early-stage venture investor in over 75 companies and is a Founder and CIO at Northpoint Capital. Previously, Sameer was the MD/GP at Nexus Venture Partners, where he established and led their Bangalore office. He has led investments at inception or early stages at Postman, Unacademy, Hasura.io, Infra.market, Paytm, Zomato, Slice, Bira91, Licious, Pristyn Care, Triomics, Animall, Ultrahuman, EpiFI, Rocketlane, CapGrid, SmartStaff, Zolo, Quandl (Nasdaq), Newton School, Jumbotail, Blue Tokai, Tessolve Semiconductor amongst several others. He is the Founder and Managing Partner at Breakthrough Capital, Broadbridge Capital Management, and Firestone Capital Management (his vehicles to invest in listed and private tech companies globally). Sameer's past experiences include being a founding member at Reliance Ventures (Reliance Group's VC arm) and as an operator at Ericsson AB, UTStarcom Inc, and American Wireless Broadband. Sameer is also a Kamalnayan Bajaj Fellow at the Aspen Institute and also an OnDeck Health Fellow, Kautilya Fellow, member of FT's Climate Capital Council, Global Panel Member at MIT Tech Review, and a member of VC Sector Core Council at the Indian Venture Capital Association. He was voted as '40 under 40 Alternative Investment Professionals' in India by IAAIF. He has a BS in Computer Engineering from the Illinois Institute of Technology, Chicago where he was an International and Founders Scholar.

people.name: Sanjay Parikh
people.role: Executive Vice President and Member of the Board, Indegene
people.education: PhD, Biomedical Engineering (The Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine)
bio: Sanjay Parikh is a Founder of Plaksha. He is Executive Vice President and Member of the Board of Indegene. He has more than 25 years of experience in strategy, business development, and operations in the pharmaceutical, medical devices, and healthcare industries across most developed and developing markets.

He has a BTech degree in Electrical Engineering from IIT Bombay, a master's degree in Clinical Engineering from Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland, and a PhD in Biomedical Engineering from the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Baltimore, MD. Sanjay has also been a visiting faculty member at the School of Biomedical Engineering of IIT Bombay.

people.name: Snehal Shah
people.role: Independent Director, Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
bio: Snehal Shah is a Founder of Plaksha. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from Sardar Patel University and a Postgraduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) with a specialization in Finance from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

He has over 21 years of experience in private equity, having held senior roles at ICICI Venture, Actis, and Fairwinds. In 2016, he stepped away from active corporate life to explore personal interests such as trekking and travel. Recently, Snehal has taken up a board role as an Independent Director at Gala Precision Engineering Limited, where he brings his extensive industry insight and strategic acumen.

people.name: Sriram Nadathur
bio: Sriram Nadathur is a Founder of Plaksha. He is an entrepreneur, angel investor, and co-head of Nadathur Group. He leads the group's private investments in biotech, healthcare, materials science, nature-inspired innovation, and related deep-tech sectors. Sriram has also served on the board of the group's hospitality business, as well as the group's technology arm, investing in a wide range of startups.
Prior to joining Nadathur Group, Sriram worked in startups and also co-founded Syndicated Research Group, a subscription-based research business serving CXOs of F500 companies.

people.name: Subrata Mitra
bio: Subrata Mitra is a Founder of Plaksha. He is a Partner at Accel India since 2008. He co-founded Erasmic Venture Fund and helped launch Accel's India office.

With a focus on AI, consumer and fintech, he has backed iconic startups such as Flipkart, Myntra and Curefit. He was ranked number 38 on the 2023 Forbes Midas List. He brings over four decades of operational and investment expertise, mentoring founders and scaling ventures globally.
He holds a bachelor's from IIT Kanpur, a master's from Delaware, and a PhD from the University of Illinois.
At Plaksha, Subrata Mitra will be sharing his expertise at the Binny Bansal Institute for Inventing the Future.

people.name: Vikas Taneja
people.role: Managing Director and Senior Partner, Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
bio: Vikas Taneja is a Founder of Plaksha. He is a Managing Director and Senior Partner with the Boston Consulting Group. He is the global leader of BCG's GrowthTech business. Vikas is also on the Global Leadership Team of BCG's Technology, Media, and Telecom practice. Vikas was previously the leader of BCG's Marketing and Sales practices in the Americas and the Global Head of the Sales and Go-to-market topic for BCG.

Vikas's commercial focus has been on achieving profitable growth at major corporations. He has led major programs to improve business performance through improving sales productivity, product portfolio improvements, process reengineering, and organization restructuring. Vikas has worked extensively with software, technology, and IT services companies on topics such as improving software sales process and compressing turnaround times, sales growth, sales productivity, and metrics.

Prior to joining BCG, Vikas worked at ARCH Technology Partners where he evaluated and helped commercialize new technologies emerging from University of Chicago's academic labs and medical school. Vikas has also worked in the Information and Technology group at McKinsey and Co.

Vikas received his MBA with Honors in Economics and Finance from the University of Chicago. He also holds a Bachelor of Arts and Sciences in Computer Systems Engineering and Economic Development from Stanford University.
Vikas previously led the Boston chapter of Pratham, an India-based organization that has worked with over 4 million children to help them achieve literacy and basic mathematics skills.

people.name: Vikram Sehgal
bio: Vikram Sehgal is a Founder of Plaksha. He is a Co-founder and responsible for managing Nagarro's global operations. Under his stewardship, the company's operations have steadily grown in personnel, infrastructure and capabilities. Vikram has extensive experience in large-scale project management, resource and capacity management, establishing quality processes and fast ramp-ups. He has been overseeing implementations in several domains including SCADA systems, regulatory pharmaceuticals, product engineering and manufacturing optimization. Vikram has more than 19 years of IT industry experience. He is a gold medalist in Electronics and Communications Engineering from REC Kurukshetra.

people.name: Yogesh Agrawal
bio: Yogesh Agrawal is a Founder of Plaksha. He is Managing Director of Ajanta Pharma. A management graduate from Johnson and Wales University, USA, he joined the company in 1996 and grew up the ranks to become Managing Director. It is under his leadership that Ajanta Pharma made a corporate turnaround and emerged as a leading branded generic player from India having strong footprint in its chosen markets. He spearheads Ajanta's foray in the regulated and emerging international markets. He has transformed the company’s research program and manufacturing capabilities by setting up state-of-the-art facilities that meet stringent regulatory requirements.
His passion towards research and development has fuelled the company’s growth. He built a robust R&D division powered by 800 scientists.

His core competencies include strong business acumen, strategic intelligence, execution abilities and governance. He has received numerous accolades, including TIME’s 'Young Maker of the Year' award presented by Shri Narendra Modi, Prime Minister of India, and CNBC’s 'CEO of the Year - Next Gen' recognition.

people.name: Swapneel Premchand
bio: CS + AI student at Plaksha University running production software before finishing college. Founded Tulips.edu, a school ERP live in three schools, and works as the sole engineer in Flyback's Founder's Office.
Hack-n-Win 3.0: 1st of 450. Plaksha Medithon: 2nd. Onboarded 300+ students to AWS as a campus ambassador.
